question: Which of the following glands occur in pairs in human beings?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Adrenal, Ovaries**__.

__**Concept:**__

__
 
• **Endocrine glands** are **ductless glands**, i.e., lack ducts. 
 
• They release their secretion into the surrounding bloodstream for transport to the site of action or a distant target organ.
 
• **Examples: **Hypothalamus, Pituitary gland, Thyroid gland, Adrenal gland, Ovaries, etc.

Explanation:__

__
 
• **Adrenal Gland: **

 
 
• In human beings, **Adrenal glands are present in pairs.**
 
• Each gland is** located at the anterior portion of each kidney.**
 
• Adrenal glands are conical yellowish bodies composed of **two types of tissues** i.e.,** Adrenal cortex** and **Adrenal medulla.**
 
 
 
• **Ovaries:**
 
 
• These are the** primary sex organ in females **that serve to produce ova (female gametes) and female sex hormones.
 
• A **pair of ovaries** are** located in the pelvic cavity **(in the abdomen).
 
• It is an almond-shaped structure. 
 
 
 
• While **Thyroid gland, Pancreas, **and **Pituitary gland **are **not present in pairs** in human beings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6829055c0108ed96d8ba442b8569faa08692f812f7d8e6601f21dd6140983d7e.png] 

Thus, **Adrenal gland and Ovaries occur in pairs in human beings.**__
